:::{#exr-nullity-practice}
#### Finding the nullity of a $3 \times 3$ matrix

The [nullity](#def-nullity) of a [matrix](linear-algebra-matrices.qmd#def-matrix)
is the [dimension](linear-algebra-subspaces.qmd#def-dimension) of its [null space](#def-null-space).
Let

$$
\matr{A} = \sbmat{2 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 5}.
$$

Find $\operatorname{nullity}(\matr{A})$.

::: {.callout-tip}
#### Hint

Write out $\matr{A}\vecf{x}$, find the [null space](#def-null-space), and then find a [basis](linear-algebra-subspaces.qmd#def-basis) of it.

:::
